history.summary: A spacious 1,324sqft 3BR at $1.50M / $1,133 PSF a genuine 390m from Tanah Merah MRT (EW4 interchange, D16), priced ~10% below the $1,257 URA median on a reliable 6.17% CAGR (45 txns). Excellent MRT proximity and value, offset only by the 1994 leasehold age.
history.rating_rationale: This is the strongest leasehold value in the batch: a low $1.50M absolute, ~10% below URA median PSF, a credible 6.17%/yr rate over 45 txns, and a true 5-min walk to the Tanah Merah EW interchange (best-in-batch connectivity) plus a generous 1,324sqft layout. The clear caveat is age — a 1994 99yr lease has ~67yr left, which is why the score_1000 is only 563 — but the discount, location and family-sized layout in the deepening Bayshore/upper-East-Coast corridor make the risk-reward favourable.
red_flags: Appreciation rate sample (45) is decent but not large
catalysts: 390m to Tanah Merah EWL interchange — top connectivity in batch
~10% below URA median; low $1.50M absolute = deep buyer pool
D16 upper-East-Coast / TEL Bayshore precinct momentum; large family layout
